title: Theory-Informed Quantum Error Mitigation for Shor Order Finding with Fourier Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.32923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum noise distorts the distribution of circuit measurement outcomes, often leaving enough information to infer the algorithm's correct result. To recover this latent information from the noisy distribution in Shor order finding, we introduce a theory-informed quantum error mitigation method. We model how circuit errors shift, broaden, or weaken peaks in the output distribution. These models guide both the generation of synthetic training data and the design of a Fourier neural operator with a learned gain that attenuates or amplifies higher retained Fourier modes. We score each candidate order by averaging the correlations between its ideal distribution and the distributions measured in three circuit executions. The network adjusts these scores to guide the order estimate and determine the weights of a normalized mixture of the ideal distributions. On 1,351 simulated test cases for general modular exponentiation, held out by circui

translated_title: 基于傅里叶神经算子的理论引导量子误差缓解方法用于Shor求阶算法
translated_abstract: 量子噪声会扭曲电路测量结果的分布，但通常仍保留足够的信息来推断算法的正确结果。为了从Shor求阶算法的噪声分布中恢复这些潜在信息，我们提出了一种理论引导的量子误差缓解方法。我们对电路误差如何使输出分布中的峰发生偏移、展宽或减弱进行建模。这些模型既指导合成训练数据的生成，也指导傅里叶神经算子的设计，该算子具有可学习的增益，能够衰减或放大所保留的较高傅里叶模态。我们通过将每个候选阶的理想分布与三次电路执行中测得的分布之间的相关性进行平均，来对每个候选阶进行评分。网络调整这些评分以指导阶的估计，并确定理想分布归一化混合的权重。在针对一般模幂运算的1351个模拟测试用例上（由电路……留出测试）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种理论引导的量子误差缓解方法，通过建模电路误差对输出分布峰值的偏移、展宽和减弱效应，并利用带可学习增益的傅里叶神经算子，从噪声测量分布中有效恢复Shor求阶算法的正确阶估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a theory-informed quantum error mitigation method that models how circuit errors shift, broaden, or weaken output distribution peaks and employs a Fourier neural operator with learned gains to recover correct order estimates in Shor's algorithm from noisy measurement distributions.
